title: Align the trusted Engram help resolver with the host's configured-program launch resolution
outcome: The help permission exception and actual Engram host launch resolve a configured native program to the same executable identity, with deliberate unsupported configuration forms documented and refused.
acceptance: A shared resolver or an explicitly justified narrower contract prevents help admission from trusting a different executable than the host would launch for the same supported configured native program.

Regression coverage checks configured absolute paths and Windows native basename search precedence, including application/system directories versus PATH, without mutating process-wide test environment concurrently.
The maintained gate passes on the final input.
